name: image-preview
description: See the pictures in your prompt: thumbnails above the prompt for pastes, @-mentioned files and the clipboard, with the real picture laid over them on Windows, plus a gallery and clipboard paste and copy. Windows, macOS, Linux and WSL.

renderer.title: Thumbnail style
renderer.description: auto: real pictures where Claude Code draws them (kitty, Ghostty), colored blocks elsewhere. pictures or blocks: always that style. off: no thumbnails above the prompt.

tile_rows.title: Thumbnail height
tile_rows.description: How many rows a thumbnail may take above the prompt (2 to 32). More rows show more detail; thumbnails shrink when the band has less room.

overlay.title: Real pictures over the blocks (Windows)
overlay.description: Windows (console, Git Bash, Windows Terminal, VS Code, WezTerm, Alacritty): a small window lays each picture exactly over its colored blocks, at full resolution; a click opens it. Where a terminal tells nothing of its cells, it finds the tiles on screenshots of the terminal window, kept in memory only.

read_previews.title: Preview pictures Claude reads
read_previews.description: A small thumbnail under each picture Claude opens with the Read tool, such as a screenshot it took, and a place for it in the gallery. Off: those files are left alone.
